csv_project_name: AE for St. Cloud Sky Central Airport
csv_scope_of_work: The Saint Cloud Regional Airport Authority (Authority) is requesting Statements of Qualifications from interested and qualified Aviation Consultants for Professional On-Call Airport Planning, Environmental, Engineering, and Architectural Services at St. Cloud Sky Central Airport for the next five (5) years. Professional, technical, and advisory services are needed for projects identified in the Airport s Capital Improvement Program (CIP). Projects may include airport planning services, environmental services, airside / landside design, construction administration, airport building design, and AIP program management. The projects anticipated to occur in the next five years include: Planning Services: 1. Master Plan and Airport Layout Plan Update 2. AGIS / Aeronautical Survey 3. Obstruction Removal 4. Airspace Analysis 5. Land and Property Acquisition, which could include surveying, appraisal, review appraisal, real estate, and title services 6. Strategic / Business / Financial Planning Environmental and Engineering Services: 1. Environmental documents related to CIP projects 2. Wildlife Hazard Assessment and/or Wildlife Hazard Management Plan 3. Parking Lot Pavement Rehabilitation and Expansion 4. Runway, Taxiway, and Taxilane Pavement Rehabilitation, Reconstruction, and Expansion 5. General Aviation Ramp Pavement Rehabilitation, Reconstruction, and Expansion 6. Commercial Ramp Pavement Rehabilitation, Reconstruction, and Expansion 7. Airfield Lighting Improvement Design and Construction 8. Fuel System Upgrades 9. Perimeter Fence Improvements 10. Building / Hangar Civil Sitework and Utility Design and Construction 11. SRE Equipment Acquisition Architectural Services: 1. Hangar Design and Construction 2. General Aviation Arrivals / Departures Terminal Building Design & Construction 3. SRE Building Expansion 4. Airport Terminal Renovation.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering, Transportation Planning
